admin.inventory.export_intro: One row per product: its SKU, price and stock, and its slug and name for reference. Edit only the price and stock columns; leave the "at export" columns as they are.

admin.inventory.import_rule_match: Each row finds its product by SKU, in this store only, and sets its stock on hand and / or its price (an empty cell leaves that value as it is). Nothing else of the product changes. Every stock change is logged in the product's stock movements.

admin.inventory.import_rule_refused: Refused rows (nothing of them is applied): unknown SKU, a SKU that appears more than once in the file, a row without SKU, a non-whole or negative stock, a negative price or one with more than 2 decimals or a comma (write 6499.00), a row with neither stock nor price, a row of another store.
